points.description: Label the training data with positive and negative (+/-) class labels.
Initialise the weights randomly before learning starts.
Apply the (simplified) update rule Δw = η·x(n) for a data point x(n) when <w,x> ≤ 0, as stated in the model answer. The update must be given with its condition and the learning rate η.
points.partial_credit: 0.2 if the update Δw = η·x(n) is given but the condition <w,x> ≤ 0 is missing or wrong

points.description: Repeat the update over all data points in epochs until the weights do not change much (stopping condition).
points.partial_credit: 0.2 if the repetition over epochs is stated but no stopping condition on the weights is given

points.description: State that the algorithm converges because the data is linearly separable.

rubric.notes: Full marks need all five elements in a pseudo-code or step list: +/- labels, random weight initialisation, the update Δw = η·x(n) applied when <w,x> ≤ 0, repetition over epochs until the weights stop changing much, and convergence because the data is linearly separable. Accept the update condition exactly as the model answer gives it (<w,x> ≤ 0); a clearly equivalent misclassification condition with the label included is also acceptable. Part marks only for the two partially stated points listed; a missing or wrong element earns nothing, and vague wording such as "it learns the weights" does not count as the update rule or the stopping condition.
